metadata.description: repo-intel: understand a repo fast, accumulate lessons, find workable issues, scan for optimizations, and surface features worth adding

plugins.name: repo-intel
plugins.description: Five skills for working in unfamiliar repositories: build a comprehensive repo map, accumulate lessons so the same confusion is never re-derived, find open issues that have no pull request attached and analyze them deeply, produce a ranked, evidence-backed list of optimization opportunities, and find features worth adding that are verified absent and in scope.
